meta.name: tprm
meta.description: Expert third-party risk management (TPRM) advisor — a vendor risk analyst for the full lifecycle: risk-based vendor tiering, tailored due-diligence questionnaires (SIG-style or mapped to ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA, NIS2, HIPAA), SOC 2 Type II report review (exceptions, carve-outs, CUECs, bridge letters), DPA and sub-processor review under GDPR Art. 28, contract security addenda (DORA Art. 30 provisions), ongoing monitoring programmes, and vendor offboarding. Use this skill whenever a user mentions vendor risk, supplier due diligence, third-party assessments, security questionnaires, reviewing a vendor's SOC 2 report, vendor tiering, fourth parties or sub-processors, supply chain security requirements, DORA ICT third-party rules, business associate agreements, or exit/termination of a vendor. Also trigger for 'a customer sent us a questionnaire' and 'how do I assess this vendor' style requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估第三方供应商风险,定制尽调问卷并解读合规报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要评估供应商安全合规风险、审阅其 SOC 2 报告或处理客户发来的安全问卷。
copy.tagline_en: Assess vendor risk, run due-diligence questionnaires, review vendor reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assess supplier risk, review SOC 2 reports, or field customer questionnaires.

howto.what: Claude 会以供应商风险分析师的身份工作:按风险给供应商分级、生成尽调问卷、审查 SOC 2 Type II 报告(意见/例外/CUEC/分包)、审查 DPA 与合同安全附录,并给出监控和退出清单。
howto.when: 当你提到供应商风险、供应商尽调、第三方评估等,或问“客户发来一份问卷”“怎么评估这个供应商”时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这家供应商做风险分级
say.note: 会给出分级模型和每级的尽调深度

say.text: 审一下这份 SOC 2 Type II 报告,列出例外和 CUEC
say.note: 按意见、期间、分包、例外逐项分析

say.text: 这份 DPA 的 GDPR Art. 28(3) 条款有没有缺项
say.note: 逐条标出存在、缺失或不足

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a vendor risk analyst: tiers vendors by risk, generates due-diligence questionnaires, reviews SOC 2 Type II reports (opinion, exceptions, CUECs), reviews DPAs and security addenda, plus monitoring/offboarding checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered by vendor risk, supplier due diligence, third-party assessments, SOC 2 report review, sub-processors or DORA ICT third-party rules, or 'a customer sent us a questionnaire'.

say_en.text: Tier this vendor by risk for me
say_en.note: Returns a tier model and per-tier diligence depth

say_en.text: Review this SOC 2 Type II report: list exceptions and CUECs
Check this DPA against GDPR Art. 28(3)
say_en.note: Flags each clause as present, absent or deficient
